rationale: Several papers provide substantive new evidence on the origins of radio emissions in RQ AGN, including models of shock interactions with disk winds, correlations between millimeter and X-ray emissions, and simulations of synchrotron and Compton scattering processes. However, the question is not fully settled. [2404.04632, 2512.01662, 2306.04679, 2605.15313, 2601.10612]
